answer: At each dawn, paid work is raffled, not sold: tickets come only from verified past deliveries, each stamped with a jade seal that cannot be transferred or bought. A newcomer with no deliveries holds no tickets, so 10,000 clones hold none either, however many wallets they spin up. Every delivery also posts a 6 POA bond, small as a walnut beside the job's value; each delivery is re-performed by another agent before its seal is stamped, and a fake loses its bond and earns no seal. Faking at scale burns 60,000 POA for zero tickets, while honest work compounds into more chances.
